A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 19-page versions of the same UVGS work, including supplementary material on pages 12–19. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison without material gaps.

before.justification: v3 reports original reconstruction/compression measurements, generation comparisons, inpainting results, and ablations in Section 4, plus supplementary interpolation and real-scene reconstruction results.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including main Tables 1–3, supplementary Table 4, and qualitative reconstruction, generation, inpainting, and interpolation examples.

M1.justification: Spherical mapping, opacity-based dynamic selection, multiple UVGS layers, branched forward/inverse networks, reconstruction losses, and diffusion procedures are unchanged. Supplementary Algorithm 1 and architecture details also match.

E1.justification: Both retain the same Objaverse-derived data and ShapeNet cars, with reconstruction/compression, unconditional and text-conditioned generation, inpainting, interpolation, and supplementary real-scene reconstruction coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the corresponding tables and qualitative comparisons. Tables 2 and supplementary 4 retain Get3D, DiffTF, EG3D, and GaussianCube for unconditional generation, and DreamGaussian, Shap. E, LGM, and GaussianCube for text-conditioned generation.

E3.justification: Both retain 88-view fitting for 10K iterations, the same UVGS resolutions and training settings, and evaluation using 20K unconditional and 10K text-conditioned generated samples. Metrics and supplementary experimental procedures are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the same layer-count, resolution, and branching ablations. Supplementary Figure 3 retains the layer-count comparison for scene reconstruction, and Figure 5 retains the interpolation study; no analysis or case study is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both use the same point-estimate reporting and provide no repeated-run counts, seed specifications, error bars, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Main Tables 1–3 and supplementary Table 4 have identical entries and values. For example, UVGS retains FID 26.20, KID 3.24, and CLIP score 32.62 in Tables 2 and 4. Qualitative result images and reported findings also match.

T1.justification: The Gaussian and spherical-mapping definitions, network expressions, reconstruction losses, and diffusion objectives are unchanged throughout the main text and supplement. No formal assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about structured and scalable UVGS, compact Super UVGS, compatibility with pretrained image models, and applications to compression, generation, and inpainting.

C2.justification: The branching rationale and interpretations of reconstruction and generation results are unchanged. Both retain the limitations concerning washed-out appearance, single-layer representation of complex objects/scenes, and inefficient use of empty pixels.

D1.justification: Page 1 changes the project address from aashishrai3799.github.io/uvgs to ivl.cs.brown.edu/uvgs, updating access information. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, and training budgets remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish a new code or data release.

R1.justification: Related-work discussion and all 70 reference entries are unchanged, including positioning relative to voxel, triplane, and other structured Gaussian representations.

P1.justification: The first-page project address and arXiv version/date stamp are updated from v3, 20 March 2025, to v4, 1 December 2025. Body wording, section order, and supplementary organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All main and supplementary figures retain identical image content, captions, and placement. Table structures and page layouts also remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v4 retains the scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, and visual presentation of v3, including the supplement. The project-address and version-stamp updates provide no additional implementation documentation or demonstrated expansion of resource availability, leaving overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
